notes: 인터랙티브 인터뷰 스킬이므로 시뮬레이션 유저 프로토콜로 평가한다: 서브에이전트가 AskUserQuestion 페이로드를 questions_round_N.json으로 기록하고, briefs/의 히든 브리프에 따라 유저 역할로 답한 뒤 인터뷰를 계속한다.

evals.name: payment-failure-notification-kr
evals.expected_output: 운영자 대상 이메일 알림으로 좁혀진 Before/After 스펙. 고객 알림 오해를 옵션 설계로 조기에 해소하고, 성공 기준(5분 내 수신, 중복 없음)이 요약에 포함됨.

assertions.text: State file created in project/.claude/ with iteration, max_iterations, original_requirement, and ISO-8601 started_at frontmatter
Every question round has at most 4 questions, batched as a single payload
Every question offers 2-4 concrete hypothesis options (no open-ended-only questions)

Exit/termination handling is honest and economical: the interview stops as soon as nothing material remains, never exceeds max rounds, and any exit option offered does not displace a needed hypothesis option
Final output contains Before (verbatim original) and After sections with Goal/Scope/Constraints/Success Criteria and a decisions table
Promise tag <promise>CLARIFICATION COMPLETE</promise> emitted at the end
Interview resolves the recipient trap: final spec targets the operator, not the customer, traceable to an asked question
No fabricated requirements: every decision in the summary traces to a brief answer or an explicitly recorded assumption
Round-1 questions lead with architecture/design-changing decisions (who is it for, what triggers it, what is in scope) rather than administrative details
Interview surfaces at least one material unknown-unknown the user never stated, and it lands in the final spec as a decision or explicit assumption
Final spec separates user decisions, assistant assumptions (defaults), and residual unknowns
